resources.string:
This app pairs with the ZCode desktop app on your computer. Pairing grants the app the same control as the desktop’s phone remote: view tasks and conversations, stream agent output, and approve or deny permission requests.

What leaves your phone: only the traffic needed to talk to your paired desktop, through the ZCode relay (or a server you configure later). Nothing else — no analytics, no tracking.

Keep the pairing link private: anyone holding it can operate your desktop window.
Scanning the QR code shown by ZCode desktop requires the camera. You can also paste the pairing link instead — the desktop\u2019s remote-control dialog offers \u201cCopy the link\u201d.
Open ZCode desktop → Remote Control → point the camera at the QR code.
Desktop → Remote Control → Copy the link, then paste it here.
This is not a valid ZCode pairing link
Nothing was saved. Check that you copied the full link from the desktop\u2019s Remote Control dialog and try again.
This QR code may be stale
The link was generated more than 10 minutes ago. It usually still works — but if pairing fails, refresh the QR on the desktop and scan again.
The desktop app reports version %1$s. This app supports ZCode desktop %2$s or newer. Update the desktop app and regenerate the QR code.
The desktop reports version %1$s, newer than the newest version this app was tested against (%2$s). Pairing will probably work; the app checks the protocol version during connection.
Your pairing credential will be sealed with hardware-backed encryption on this device. It never leaves the device except to answer the relay\u2019s authentication challenges.
This device supports biometric unlock. You can require it when revealing or removing the pairing credential.
This device has no secure lock screen, so the sealed credential is only as safe as this device. You can continue with reduced security, or set a screen lock in Android settings and pair afterwards.
Authenticating with the pairing credential. This usually takes a few seconds.
Pairing failed — the link was rejected
The relay rejected this pairing link. It may have been refreshed or revoked on the desktop. Generate a fresh QR code and scan it again.
Another ZCode Remote page or device took over the connection — the desktop allows one at a time. You can reconnect, which takes the connection back.
Connected to %1$s. Task and conversation surfaces arrive in a later build — pairing, security and recovery are active.
This deletes the pairing credential and all key material on this phone. Also press Stop in the desktop\u2019s Remote Control dialog — closing the dialog does not stop remote control.
